display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
we_sync, re_sync reg, 3 bits each
rst → 3'b111
every edge ← {sync[1:0], pin}
we_rise = we_sync[1] & !we_sync[2]
re_rise = re_sync[1] & !re_sync[2]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center; width: 440px;

span.p:
host decode
control_write = we_rise & addr == 3
rom_cmd = wdata[7:4] == 0
run_ram_cmd = wdata == 0x10
load_cmd = wdata == 0x20
restart = control_write & (rom_cmd | run_ram_cmd | load_cmd)
tx_push = we_rise & addr == 0 & !load_mode
prog_byte = we_rise & addr == 0 & load_mode
rx_pop = re_rise & addr == 1
rdata: 0 → 0; 1 → rx_empty ? 0 : rx_data;
2 → {5'b0, halted, tx_full, rx_empty};
3 → load_mode ? 0x20 : ram_select ? 0x10 : {4'b0, sel}

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center; width: 440px;

span.p:
sel reg, 4 bits; ram_select, load_mode reg, 1 bit each
rst → 0
control_write & rom_cmd → sel ← wdata[3:0], ram_select ← 0, load_mode ← 0
control_write & run_ram_cmd → ram_select ← 1, load_mode ← 0
control_write & load_cmd → ram_select ← 1, load_mode ← 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center; width: 440px;

span.p:
byte_phase reg, 1 bit; prog_low reg, 8 bits;
prog_addr reg, 8 bits; prog_words reg, 9 bits
rst, load_cmd → all 0
rom_cmd, run_ram_cmd → byte_phase ← 0
prog_byte & prog_words < 256:
byte_phase 0 → prog_low ← wdata, byte_phase ← 1
byte_phase 1 → byte_phase ← 0, prog_addr + 1, prog_words + 1
prog_we = prog_byte & byte_phase & prog_words < 256
prog_wdata = {wdata, prog_low}

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rom
16 slots, 16 bits wide
rom_word = slot[sel][imem_addr]
rom_words = slot[sel]'s length
(slot 0: 0 words)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ram 256 × 16 bits
prog_we → mem[prog_addr] ← prog_wdata
ram_word = mem[imem_addr] (combinational)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
fetch mux
imem_word = ram_select ? ram_word : rom_word
program_words = load_mode ? 0 :
ram_select ? prog_words : rom_words

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
top
core + TX / RX FIFOs, see core_*.svg
tx_data = host_wdata
imem_addr = pc[7:0] back to rom and ram
tx_full, rx_empty, halted, rx_data back to host decode
